title: AI Taking Over Junior Dev Jobs?
full_monologue: **AI agents are replacing junior developers.** Let’s talk about this. These AI tools can now write clean code, debug issues, and even understand project requirements—fast. They’re not just assisting; they’re stepping into roles once reserved for entry-level devs. But here’s the thing: AI isn’t replacing creativity or problem-solving. It’s changing the game. So, what does this mean for the future of coding? Let me know in the comments.
